name: Mayoi no Mori no Kusuguri Shokushu
original_name: 迷いの森のくすぐり触手
source:
A strong-minded girl Lisa is tickled by tentacles in the Labyrinthine Forest.
Having all four limbs bound, she can't escape from tickling even if she faints...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE212980.html]DLsite English[/url]]
